```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr)

# Set up working directory (use project-root paths)
if (!file.exists(here::here("R", "cache_config.R"))) {
  stop("Cannot find helper file. Check that here::here returns the project root")
}
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
# FReD-specific configuration (dataset-independent)
FRED_GSHEET_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv"
SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED <- params$include_score
SCORE_DATA_PATH <- here::here("cos_score_integration", "cos_test_set_phase1_prepared.xlsx")
FRED_OUTPUT <- here::here("output", "FReD.xlsx")

cat("\n=== FReD Preparation Pipeline ===\n")
cat("Dataset-specific configuration:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Google Sheets URL: %s\n", substr(FRED_GSHEET_URL, 1, 80)))
cat(sprintf("  SCORE Integration: %s\n", if (SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED) "ENABLED" else "DISABLED"))
cat(sprintf("  Output: %s\n", FRED_OUTPUT))
```

## Step 1: Source Helper Functions

```{r source-helpers}
cat("\n### Step 1: Loading helper functions\n")

source(here::here("R", "cache_config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data_cleaning.R"))
source(here::here("R", "crossref_cache.R"))
source(here::here("R", "augmentation.R"))

cat("✓ Helper functions loaded\n")

cat("  - CrossRef/DataCite caching\n")

cat("  - OpenAlex metadata\n")
```

## Step 2: Download FReD Data

```{r download-data}
cat("\n### Step 2: Downloading FReD data from Google Sheets\n")

# Download from Google Sheets
message("Downloading from: ", substr(FRED_GSHEET_URL, 1, 100), "...")

fred_raw <- tryCatch({
  # Skip first row (contains column descriptions, not data headers)
  read_csv(FRED_GSHEET_URL, show_col_types = FALSE, skip = 1)
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("Failed to download FReD data. Check URL and network connection.\n",
       "Error: ", e$message)
})

cat(sprintf("✓ Downloaded %d rows × %d columns\n", nrow(fred_raw), ncol(fred_raw)))

# Filter for validated - chosen status
if ("status" %in% names(fred_raw)) {
  fred_filtered <- fred_raw %>% filter(status == "validated - chosen")
  cat(sprintf("✓ Filtered for 'validated - chosen' status: %d rows\n", nrow(fred_filtered)))
} else {
  fred_filtered <- fred_raw
  warning("No 'status' column found, using all data")
}

# Remove exclusions
if ("exclusion" %in% names(fred_filtered)) {
  fred_filtered <- fred_filtered %>% filter(is.na(exclusion))
  cat(sprintf("✓ Removed excluded entries: %d rows remaining\n", nrow(fred_filtered)))
}

fred_raw <- fred_filtered
```

## Step 3: SCORE Integration (Optional)

```{r score-integration}
cat("\n### Step 3: SCORE Integration\n")

if (SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED) {
  cat("Status: ENABLED\n")

  if (file.exists(SCORE_DATA_PATH)) {
    score_data <- readxl::read_excel(SCORE_DATA_PATH)
    cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded SCORE data: %d rows\n", nrow(score_data)))

    # Ensure column compatibility - convert all common columns to character to avoid type mismatches
    # Also include statistical_success for deriving reported_success later
    common_cols <- intersect(names(fred_raw), names(score_data))
    if ("statistical_success" %in% names(score_data)) {
      common_cols <- unique(c(common_cols, "statistical_success"))
    }
    cat(sprintf("  Common columns: %d\n", length(common_cols)))

    fred_raw <- bind_rows(
      fred_raw %>%
        select(any_of(common_cols)) %>%
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
        mutate(score_entry = FALSE),
      score_data %>%
        select(any_of(common_cols)) %>%
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
        mutate(score_entry = TRUE)
    )

    cat(sprintf("✓ Merged with FReD data\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  Total rows after SCORE merge: %d\n", nrow(fred_raw)))
    cat(sprintf("  SCORE entries flagged: %d\n", sum(fred_raw$score_entry)))
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("SCORE Integration enabled but file not found: %s\n", SCORE_DATA_PATH))
  }
} else {
  cat("Status: DISABLED (use params: include_score: true to enable)\n")
  fred_raw <- fred_raw %>% mutate(score_entry = FALSE)
}
```

## Step 4: Data Cleaning

```{r cleaning}
cat("\n### Step 4: Data Cleaning\n")

cleaning_result <- clean_fred_data(fred_raw)
fred_cleaned <- cleaning_result$cleaned_data
cleaning_report <- cleaning_result$report

# Display cleaning report
cat(cleaning_report)
cat("\n✓ Data cleaning complete\n")
cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_cleaned)))
```

## Step 4b: DOI Normalization

```{r doi-normalization}
cat("\n### Step 4b: DOI Normalization\n")

# Normalize DOIs: lowercase and strip common prefixes
fred_cleaned <- fred_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    doi_o = tolower(doi_o),
    doi_r = tolower(doi_r),
    # Strip "doi:" prefix and URL prefixes
    doi_o = gsub("^(https?://)?(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", doi_o),
    doi_r = gsub("^(https?://)?(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", doi_r),
    doi_o = gsub("^doi:", "", doi_o),
    doi_r = gsub("^doi:", "", doi_r)
  )

cat("✓ DOIs normalized (lowercase, URL prefixes stripped)\n")
```

## Step 4c: DOI Validation

```{r doi-validation}
cat("\n### Step 4c: DOI Validation\n")

# Check DOI format (should start with "10.")
fred_cleaned <- fred_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    doi_o_valid = is.na(doi_o) | str_starts(doi_o, "10."),
    doi_r_valid = is.na(doi_r) | str_starts(doi_r, "10.")
  )

invalid_indices_o <- !fred_cleaned$doi_o_valid
invalid_o <- sum(invalid_indices_o)

if (invalid_o > 0) {
  show_all <- invalid_o < 10
  n_to_show <- if (show_all) invalid_o else 5
  vals <- head(fred_cleaned$doi_o[invalid_indices_o], n_to_show)
  label <- if (show_all) "Invalid doi_o values:" else "Example invalid doi_o values:"
  cat(sprintf("⚠ Found %d invalid doi_o values\n", invalid_o),
      paste(label, paste(vals, collapse = ", ")), "\n")
}

invalid_indices_r <- !fred_cleaned$doi_r_valid
invalid_r <- sum(invalid_indices_r)

if (invalid_r > 0) {
  show_all <- invalid_r < 10
  n_to_show <- if (show_all) invalid_r else 5
  vals <- head(fred_cleaned$doi_r[invalid_indices_r], n_to_show)
  label <- if (show_all) "Invalid doi_r values:" else "Example invalid doi_r values:"
  cat(sprintf("⚠ Found %d invalid doi_r values\n", invalid_r),
      paste(label, paste(vals, collapse = ", ")), "\n")
}

# Remove validation columns (keep data for now)
fred_cleaned <- fred_cleaned %>% select(-doi_o_valid, -doi_r_valid)

if (invalid_o == 0 && invalid_r == 0) {
  cat("✓ All DOIs have valid format\n")
}
```

## Step 6: Generate IDs

```{r ids}
cat("\n### Step 6: Generating identifiers\n")

fred_with_ids <- fred_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    fred_id = str_remove(id, "_[a-z]{1,2}$"),
    effect_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  group_by(ref_o, study_o, ref_r, study_r) %>%
  mutate(entry_id = first(row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("✓ Generated identifiers\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Unique fred_ids: %d\n", n_distinct(fred_with_ids$fred_id)))
cat(sprintf("  Unique entry_ids: %d\n", n_distinct(fred_with_ids$entry_id)))
```

## Step 7: Data Augmentation

```{r augmentation}
cat("\n### Step 7: Data Augmentation\n")

fred_augmented <- fred_with_ids

# Author overlap
if ("doi_o" %in% names(fred_augmented) && "doi_r" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with author overlap...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    augment_with_author_overlap(fred_augmented)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Author overlap augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })
}

# Helper function for checking non-empty text
has_text <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
count_missing <- function(x) sum(!has_text(x))
count_present <- function(x) sum(has_text(x))

# Clean references (APA + BibTeX) and individual fields with CrossRef + DataCite fallback
if (any(c("doi_o", "doi_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with clean references (APA + BibTeX) and individual fields...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    # Get unique DOIs
    unique_dois <- unique(c(fred_augmented$doi_o, fred_augmented$doi_r))
    unique_dois <- unique_dois[!is.na(unique_dois)]

    # Fetch both APA and BibTeX references with individual fields (include_fields = TRUE by default)
    refs <- get_references(unique_dois)

    # Join references and individual fields to data
    fred_augmented %>%
      left_join(
        refs %>% rename(
          doi_o = doi,
          ref_o_clean = reference_apa,
          bibtex_o = reference_bibtex,
          title_o = title,
          author_o = author,
          journal_o = journal,
          year_o = year,
          volume_o = volume,
          issue_o = issue,
          pages_o = pages
        ),
        by = "doi_o"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        refs %>% rename(
          doi_r = doi,
          ref_r_clean = reference_apa,
          bibtex_r = reference_bibtex,
          title_r = title,
          author_r = author,
          journal_r = journal,
          year_r = year,
          volume_r = volume,
          issue_r = issue,
          pages_r = pages
        ),
        by = "doi_r"
      )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Reference augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })

  # Stats BEFORE manual recovery
  cat("\n--- Reference stats (BEFORE manual recovery) ---\n")
  cat(sprintf("Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_augmented)))
  cat(sprintf("APA present:    %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$ref_o_clean),
              count_present(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("APA missing:    %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_o_clean),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("BibTeX present: %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$bibtex_o),
              count_present(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)))
  cat(sprintf("BibTeX missing: %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_o),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)))
  cat(sprintf("Title present:  %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$title_o),
              count_present(fred_augmented$title_r)))
  cat(sprintf("Title missing:  %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$title_o),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$title_r)))
  cat("  Consider adding missing refs to manual_references.xlsx\n")
}

# Manual URL reference recovery (for replication papers without DOI)
if ("url_r" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat("\n### Manual URL overrides + BibTeX title recovery (R)\n")
  before_title_r_missing <- count_missing(fred_augmented$title_r)
  before_ref_r_missing   <- count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)
  before_bib_r_missing   <- count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)

  fred_augmented <- augment_with_manual_url_refs_r(fred_augmented, verbose = TRUE)

  # Stats AFTER manual recovery
  cat("\n--- Reference stats (AFTER manual recovery) ---\n")
  cat(sprintf("Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_augmented)))
  cat(sprintf("APA present:    %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$ref_o_clean),
              count_present(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("APA missing:    %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_o_clean),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("BibTeX present: %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$bibtex_o),
              count_present(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)))
  cat(sprintf("BibTeX missing: %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_o),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)))
  cat(sprintf("Title present:  %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_present(fred_augmented$title_o),
              count_present(fred_augmented$title_r)))
  cat(sprintf("Title missing:  %d original, %d replication\n",
              count_missing(fred_augmented$title_o),
              count_missing(fred_augmented$title_r)))

  cat("\nRecovered on R side (replication):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  title_r recovered:  %d\n", before_title_r_missing - count_missing(fred_augmented$title_r)))
  cat(sprintf("  apa ref recovered:  %d\n", before_ref_r_missing   - count_missing(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("  bibtex recovered:   %d\n", before_bib_r_missing   - count_missing(fred_augmented$bibtex_r)))
}

# Fill missing author_r from bibtex_r (for DataCite/OSF entries where API didn't return authors)
if (all(c("author_r", "bibtex_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  needs_author <- which(
    (is.na(fred_augmented$author_r) | fred_augmented$author_r == "") &
    !is.na(fred_augmented$bibtex_r) & fred_augmented$bibtex_r != ""
  )
  if (length(needs_author) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\nExtracting author_r from bibtex_r for %d entries...\n", length(needs_author)))
    for (i in needs_author) {
      parsed <- parse_bibtex_fields(fred_augmented$bibtex_r[i])
      if (!is.na(parsed$author) && nzchar(parsed$author)) {
        fred_augmented$author_r[i] <- parsed$author
      }
    }
    filled <- sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$author_r[needs_author]) & fred_augmented$author_r[needs_author] != "")
    cat(sprintf("  Extracted author_r for %d entries\n", filled))
  }
}

# Same for author_o from bibtex_o
if (all(c("author_o", "bibtex_o") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  needs_author <- which(
    (is.na(fred_augmented$author_o) | fred_augmented$author_o == "") &
    !is.na(fred_augmented$bibtex_o) & fred_augmented$bibtex_o != ""
  )
  if (length(needs_author) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\nExtracting author_o from bibtex_o for %d entries...\n", length(needs_author)))
    for (i in needs_author) {
      parsed <- parse_bibtex_fields(fred_augmented$bibtex_o[i])
      if (!is.na(parsed$author) && nzchar(parsed$author)) {
        fred_augmented$author_o[i] <- parsed$author
      }
    }
    filled <- sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$author_o[needs_author]) & fred_augmented$author_o[needs_author] != "")
    cat(sprintf("  Extracted author_o for %d entries\n", filled))
  }
}

# Fill in author overlap for rows that have author data but no DOI-based overlap
if (all(c("author_o", "author_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  cat("\nFilling author overlap from existing author columns...\n")
  before_overlap <- sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$author_overlap))
  fred_augmented <- fill_author_overlap_from_columns(fred_augmented)
  after_overlap <- sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$author_overlap))
  cat(sprintf("  Author overlap: %d -> %d (filled %d)\n", before_overlap, after_overlap, after_overlap - before_overlap))
}

# Keywords (optional)
if ("doi_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with keywords...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    augment_with_keywords(fred_augmented)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Keyword augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })
}

# Language metadata from OpenAlex
if (any(c("doi_o", "doi_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with language metadata from OpenAlex...\n")

  openalex_mailto <- Sys.getenv("OPENALEX_MAILTO", NA_character_)

  # Initialize language columns if not present
  if (!"language_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
    fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>% mutate(language_o = NA_character_)
  }
  if (!"language_r" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
    fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>% mutate(language_r = NA_character_)
  }

  # Fetch for DOIs where language is missing
  dois_to_fetch_o <- fred_augmented %>%
    filter(!is.na(doi_o), is.na(language_o)) %>%
    pull(doi_o) %>% unique()

  dois_to_fetch_r <- fred_augmented %>%
    filter(!is.na(doi_r), is.na(language_r)) %>%
    pull(doi_r) %>% unique()

  cat(sprintf("  Fetching language for %d unique original DOIs and %d unique replication DOIs...\n",
              length(dois_to_fetch_o), length(dois_to_fetch_r)))

  # Fetch and join language for original DOIs
  if (length(dois_to_fetch_o) > 0) {
    fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
      meta_o <- get_openalex_language(dois_to_fetch_o, mailto = openalex_mailto)
      meta_o <- meta_o[!is.na(meta_o$doi), ]

      fred_augmented %>%
        left_join(meta_o %>% rename(doi_o = doi, language_o_new = language), by = "doi_o") %>%
        mutate(language_o = coalesce(language_o, language_o_new)) %>%
        select(-language_o_new)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Original DOI language lookup failed: ", e$message)
      fred_augmented
    })
  }

  # Fetch and join language for replication DOIs
  if (length(dois_to_fetch_r) > 0) {
    fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
      meta_r <- get_openalex_language(dois_to_fetch_r, mailto = openalex_mailto)
      meta_r <- meta_r[!is.na(meta_r$doi), ]

      fred_augmented %>%
        left_join(meta_r %>% rename(doi_r = doi, language_r_new = language), by = "doi_r") %>%
        mutate(language_r = coalesce(language_r, language_r_new)) %>%
        select(-language_r_new)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Replication DOI language lookup failed: ", e$message)
      fred_augmented
    })
  }

  cat(sprintf("  Original papers with language: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_o))))
  cat(sprintf("  Replication papers with language: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_r))))
}

cat("✓ Augmentation complete\n")
```

## Step 8: Fetch Reported Success

```{r reported-success}
cat("\n### Step 8: Fetching reported success from success coding sheet\n")

# URL for success coding (same as FLoRA uses)
SUCCESS_CODING_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSlPVImL7kjzMfpfX08JtAikvEiBg8uQ3HyEJs-YvuQMUa2RMvip-4v8-DilWl2PdwOD_UTD8gJ5wKA/pub?gid=984458430&single=true&output=csv"

reported_success <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(SUCCESS_CODING_URL, show_col_types = FALSE, skip = 1) %>%
    mutate(
      # Apply same DOI cleaning as main data: lowercase + remove all whitespace
      doi_o = tolower(gsub("\\s", "", doi_o)),
      doi_r_clean = tolower(gsub("\\s", "", doi_r)),
      id_r = coalesce(url_r, doi_r_clean)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(outcome), validation != "validated - discarded") %>%
    group_by(doi_o, id_r, study_o, study_r) %>%
    arrange(desc(validation == "validated - chosen")) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      doi_o, id_r, study_o, study_r,
      reported_success = outcome,
      reported_success_quote = outcome_quote,
      reported_success_quote_source = out_quote_source
    )
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("Failed to fetch reported success data: ", e$message)
  tibble(doi_o = character(), id_r = character(), study_o = character(),
         study_r = character(), reported_success = character(),
         reported_success_quote = character(), reported_success_quote_source = character())
})

cat(sprintf("✓ Fetched %d reported success entries\n", nrow(reported_success)))

# Create id_r for joining (apply same cleaning as success coding sheet)
fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
  mutate(id_r = coalesce(url_r, tolower(gsub("\\s", "", doi_r))))

# Join reported success to data
fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
  left_join(reported_success, by = c("doi_o", "id_r", "study_o", "study_r"))

# Fill in from existing outcome column where reported_success is missing
if ("outcome" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
    mutate(
      reported_success = coalesce(reported_success, outcome),
      reported_success_quote = coalesce(reported_success_quote, outcome_quote),
      reported_success_quote_source = coalesce(reported_success_quote_source, out_quote_source)
    )
}

# For SCORE entries, derive reported_success from statistical_success (like COS report does)
if ("score_entry" %in% names(fred_augmented) && "statistical_success" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  score_filled <- sum(fred_augmented$score_entry & is.na(fred_augmented$reported_success), na.rm = TRUE)
  fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
    mutate(
      reported_success = case_when(
        score_entry & is.na(reported_success) & statistical_success == "TRUE" ~ "successful",
        score_entry & is.na(reported_success) & statistical_success == "FALSE" ~ "failed",
        TRUE ~ reported_success
      ),
      reported_success_quote = case_when(
        score_entry & is.na(reported_success_quote) ~
          "NB: SCORE relied on statistical significance and direction as the leading success criterion - so reported_success coded based on that",
        TRUE ~ reported_success_quote
      ),
      reported_success_quote_source = case_when(
        score_entry & is.na(reported_success_quote_source) ~ "coding rule",
        TRUE ~ reported_success_quote_source
      )
    )
  cat(sprintf("  Derived reported_success from statistical_success for %d SCORE entries\n", score_filled))
}

# Recode onto the canonical outcome vocabulary shared with FLoRA, so both
# datasets report the same labels (see R/outcome_vocabulary.R).
source(here::here("R", "outcome_vocabulary.R"))
rs_before <- fred_augmented$reported_success
fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
  mutate(reported_success = normalise_outcome(reported_success))

rs_recodes <- outcome_recode_summary(rs_before, fred_augmented$reported_success)
if (nrow(rs_recodes) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ All reported_success values already canonical\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Recoded %d reported_success value(s):\n", sum(rs_recodes$n)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rs_recodes))) {
    cat(sprintf("      '%s' -> '%s' (%d)\n", rs_recodes$from[i], rs_recodes$to[i], rs_recodes$n[i]))
  }
}

rs_unknown <- setdiff(na.omit(unique(fred_augmented$reported_success)), VALID_OUTCOMES)
if (length(rs_unknown) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠ reported_success values outside the allowed vocabulary: %s\n",
              paste(sprintf("'%s'", rs_unknown), collapse = ", ")))
}

cat(sprintf("  Rows with reported_success: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$reported_success)),
            100 * sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$reported_success)) / nrow(fred_augmented)))
```

## Step 9: Final Column Selection and Cleanup

```{r column-cleanup}
cat("\n### Step 9: Column selection and cleanup\n")

# Coalesce clean references into main ref columns
fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>%
  mutate(
    ref_o = coalesce(ref_o_clean, ref_o),
    ref_r = coalesce(ref_r_clean, ref_r)
  )

# Define final columns (aligned with COS codebook + new augmentation columns)
final_cols <- c(
  # IDs
  "entry_id", "effect_id", "fred_id",
  # Original study
  "ref_o", "doi_o", "study_o",
  # Replication study
  "ref_r", "doi_r", "url_r", "study_r",
  # Metadata
  "author_overlap", "author_overlap_pct",
  "discipline", "tags", "description",
  # Original effect
  "claim_text_o", "claim_page_o", "n_o",
  "es_value_o", "es_type_o", "es_repr_o",
  "pval_value_o", "pval_type_o", "pval_tails_o",
  "nested_o", "prereg_o",
  # Replication effect
  "n_r", "es_value_r", "es_type_r", "es_repr_r",
  "pval_value_r", "pval_type_r", "pval_tails_r",
  "nested_r", "prereg_r",
  # Outcomes
  "reported_success", "reported_success_quote", "reported_success_quote_source",
  # Augmented reference fields
  "title_o", "author_o", "journal_o", "year_o", "volume_o", "issue_o", "pages_o",
  "title_r", "author_r", "journal_r", "year_r", "volume_r", "issue_r", "pages_r",
  "bibtex_o", "bibtex_r",
  # Language
  "language_o", "language_r"
)

# Select only columns that exist
available_cols <- intersect(final_cols, names(fred_augmented))
missing_cols <- setdiff(final_cols, names(fred_augmented))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  Note: %d expected columns not in data: %s\n",
              length(missing_cols), paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

fred_final <- fred_augmented %>%
  select(all_of(available_cols))

cat(sprintf("✓ Selected %d columns for final output\n", ncol(fred_final)))
cat(sprintf("  Dropped %d internal/working columns\n", ncol(fred_augmented) - ncol(fred_final)))
```

## Step 10: Save Output

```{r save}
cat("\n### Step 10: Saving output\n")

# Create output directory if needed
if (!dir.exists(here::here("output"))) {
  dir.create(here::here("output"))
}

# Save as Excel with formatting
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  fred_final,
  FRED_OUTPUT,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  asTable = TRUE
)

cat(sprintf("✓ Saved to: %s\n", FRED_OUTPUT))
cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_final)))
cat(sprintf("  Columns: %d\n", ncol(fred_final)))

# Summary statistics (using has_text helper for consistency)
has_text <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))

cat("\n### Summary Statistics\n")
cat(sprintf("Effect-level entries: %d\n", nrow(fred_final)))
cat(sprintf("Unique original studies: %d\n",
            n_distinct(fred_final$doi_o, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Unique replications: %d\n",
            n_distinct(fred_final$doi_r, na.rm = TRUE)))

if ("author_overlap" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Papers with author overlap data: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_final$author_overlap)),
              100 * sum(!is.na(fred_final$author_overlap)) / nrow(fred_final)))
}

if ("ref_o" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with APA reference: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$ref_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with APA reference: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$ref_r))))
}

if ("bibtex_o" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with BibTeX: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$bibtex_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with BibTeX: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$bibtex_r))))
}

if ("title_o" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with title: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$title_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with title: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$title_r))))
}

if ("reported_success" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Rows with reported_success: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$reported_success)),
              100 * sum(has_text(fred_final$reported_success)) / nrow(fred_final)))
}

if ("language_o" %in% names(fred_final)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with language metadata: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$language_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with language metadata: %d\n",
              sum(has_text(fred_final$language_r))))
}
```
